care tips: Prune infected lower foliage immediately. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation to minimize leaf wetness. Maintain adequate nitrogen and potassium soil levels. Ensure 60-90 cm row spacing for optimal airflow.
next action: Apply copper-based or chlorothalonil fungicide every 7 to 10 days. Sanitize pruning equipment.

care tips: Highly aggressive pathogen (Phytophthora infestans). Immediately cull and bag severely diseased plants. Avoid standing water in furrows. Store harvested tubers in cool, dry, well-ventilated chambers.
next action: Apply systemic translaminar fungicide (e.g., Metalaxyl, Mancozeb, or Cymoxanil) immediately. Alert neighboring plots.

care tips: Plant exhibits healthy, vigorous vegetative foliage. Continue balanced N-P-K (10-10-10 or 12-12-17) fertilization. Maintain consistent drip irrigation schedule (25-35 mm/week).
next action: Inspect underside of leaves weekly for aphid or flea beetle colonization. Apply preventive organic neem oil spray.

care tips: Requires loose, well-draining sandy loam soil with pH 5.2-6.4. Hill soil around stems when plants reach 15-20 cm height to shield developing tubers from direct sunlight and greening.
next action: Schedule mid-season potassium-rich top dressing. Check soil moisture at 15 cm depth before next irrigation cycle.

care tips: Requires warm climates, deep well-drained alluvial or black clay soils, and minimal excess humidity during boll opening. Control bollworms and sucking pests using integrated pest management.
next action: Monitor square formation and boll retention. Apply balanced potassium foliar spray during flowering stage.

care tips: Stake or cage vines to prevent soil contact. Mulch heavily with clean straw to suppress soil-borne fungal spores. Water deeply at the root zone rather than spraying canopy.
next action: Sucker indeterminate shoots to direct energy into fruit set. Apply calcium nitrate spray to prevent blossom end rot.

care tips: Requires deep nitrogen-rich soil, warm germination temperatures (>15°C), and timely weed control during the first 30 days of seedling establishment.
next action: Apply secondary urea top-dressing at knee-high (V6) vegetative stage. Monitor field perimeter for fall armyworm egg masses.

care tips: Maintain shallow standing water (3-5 cm) during tillering to flowering stages. Apply silicon fertilizer to reinforce cell walls against blast fungus and stem borers.
next action: Drain field 10 days prior to anticipated harvest. Inspect flag leaves for bacterial leaf blight lesions.

care tips: Sow at optimal soil temperature (18-20°C). Apply balanced nitrogen in two splits (basal and crown root initiation). Ensure well-aerated seedbed to prevent root rot.
next action: Inspect tiller density at CRI stage. Apply irrigation at heading and milk-grain stages for maximum grain filling.
